title: ArchReview-KG Demo — M6 Cut

shots.caption: Manual code review is slow and lacks a paper trail
One command: archkg review on a real Cambridge MA PDF
Issues lifecycle: candidate → confirmed / rejected / superseded
Per-rule precision, recall, calibration — audited by archreview-test-judge
Deploy in 5 minutes: docker compose up, or archkg-pilot init
Honest limitations — over-detection, count-level recall, MA-only sourcing
Open source. AI-narrated. Next: real reviewer labels + M7

notes: Storyboard generated alongside voiceover.wav; per-shot durations are exact TTS render times measured via ffprobe.
Each shot's start/end define when its caption + screen-capture clip play in the final mp4 (M6.W7).
